meta_description:
228K likes, 187 comments - elleindia on September 12, 2026: "#ELLEDigitalCoverStars: There is something inherently cinematic about rebellion. But playing a revolutionary is not simply a matter of putting on a period costume and looking suitably serious while history unfolds around you. For Bhuvan Bam (@bhuvan.bam22), Gurfateh Pirzada (@gurfatehpirzada), Pratibha Ranta (@pratibha_ranta) and Rohit Saraf (@rohitsaraf), stepping into these roles meant working against familiar instincts and screen personas. As Rash Behari Bose, Bagha Jatin, Pratibha Lahiri and Sachindra Nath Sanyal in Prime Video’s new drama series, ‘The Revolutionaries,’ they inhabit a world where conviction has consequences, and every decision could be a matter of life or death. Head to the 🔗 in the bio to read the conversation with our digital cover stars.
______________________________________
On @bhuvan.bam22: Armaan Jodhpuri set by @gopivaiddesigns. Jardim mirror necklace by @isharya. 

On @gurfatehpirzada: Taraash kurta set by @gopivaiddesigns. Zephyra necklace by @isharya. 

On @pratibha_ranta: Ira lehenga set by @gopivaiddesigns. Aralia earrings by @anitadongre. Idyllic oval cut bracelet by @swarovski

On @rohitsaraf: Pranav kurta set by @gopivaiddesigns. Nesma layered necklace by @anitadongre
________________________________________

Hair: Arbaz Ali (@arbazshaikh6210) (Pratibha), Sahil More (@sahilmore_hair) (Bhuvan), Tanik Padam Singh (@style_by_tanik) (Rohit), Tejbahadur Kumar (@hairby_tej) (Gurfateh)
